model_output.verdict: An ICU nurse with specific critical care experience and one committee role that needs more detail.
write_up: You look like a strong fit for staff nursing work in an ICU or telemetry unit. Your Arizona RN license, CCRN and current ICU work are easy to find. The main question is what you do on the sepsis committee beyond membership.
The direct-care line is a good model: two critically ill patients per shift in a 24-bed medical ICU. It tells a recruiter what your work looks like without making them guess.

fit.note: Your recent work points toward ICU staff nursing, with earlier telemetry experience. The charge and precepting duties add to the clinical picture without claiming a management role.
